summary: More 2.6 API replacements: object_roles becomes role_user_assignments filtered by content_type__api_slug and object_id (for example awx.credential), access_list becomes /api/gateway/v1/role_user_access/<slug>/<id>/, hub keycloak login moves to /api/gateway/social/complete/<UID>/ and hub tokens to gateway tokens; EDA gets gateway org, team, user and role endpoints.
questions: How do I list who has access to a credential in AAP 2.6?
How do I get automation hub tokens in AAP 2.6?

answer_card.title: Who has access to a resource
answer_card.answer_md:
2.4: `/api/v2/credentials/42/access_list/`

2.6: `/api/gateway/v1/role_user_access/awx.credential/42/`

To list role assignments on a resource: `/api/gateway/v1/role_user_assignments/?content_type__api_slug=awx.credential&object_id=42`
